looks.name: Santa
looks.notes: White at the pinnacle and down to the coat · red coat · black belt with a gold buckle on every face · red coat · white trim · red pants · white boot tops.

looks.name: Santa's Hat
looks.notes: The whole tree is the hat: red up to the balcony ridge, a fluffy white brim at the ground ring, and the pinnacle is the white puff. The fur sparkles.

looks.name: Frosty
looks.notes: His black hat with a red band is the pinnacle. Three shaded snowballs stacked down the tree, coal eyes and a bright carrot on every face, a red-and-white striped scarf, coal buttons.

looks.name: Rudolph
looks.notes: No antlers: brown, the tan stripe, and a scalloped hem low on the tree; where each pair of scallops meets, a red nose glows and pulses, two eyes above it. The pinnacle washes red.

looks.name: Snowfall
looks.notes: Snow falling in front of a ring of dark pines, the night sky brightening to a glow just above the treetops.

looks.name: Snowflakes
looks.notes: Six-armed flakes tumbling as they fall, on bright blue; the pinnacle glows white.

looks.name: Gifts
looks.notes: Two parcels on opposite sides, wrapped in diagonal stripes and no bows: red and gold on one, the Pride flag on the other.

looks.name: Candy Cane
looks.notes: Red and white spiralling from the ridge to the ground, turning.

looks.name: Peppermint
looks.notes: A peppermint pinwheel on every face, each spinning in place, between green bands; red pinnacle.

looks.name: Holly
looks.notes: Holly sprigs, two to a face, on dark green; the red berries twinkle, and the pinnacle is a berry.

looks.name: Bells
looks.notes: Two big pairs of gold bells on opposite sides, swinging under a red bow, on green; gold pinnacle.

looks.name: Stars
looks.notes: Gold and white stars on night blue, a big star on every face of the pinnacle; they twinkle.

looks.name: Menorah
looks.notes: A nine-branched menorah on every face, the shamash raised, on bands of blue: blue, darkest blue, dark blue, blue, lighter blue. Only the flames flicker.

looks.name: Dreidel
looks.notes: The whole tree is one dreidel: a silver handle at the pinnacle, a blue body with silver corners, one great gold letter on each face (nun, gimel, hey, shin), tapering to its point; the tree turns, so it spins its letters past you.

looks.name: Kinara
looks.notes: A kinara on every face, its holder in gold and brown: three red candles, the black one in the centre, three green; behind it, warm bands of gold and brown. Only the flames flicker.

looks.name: Kwanzaa Bands
looks.notes: Red over black over green, rising slowly; red pinnacle.

looks.name: Doves
looks.notes: White doves with olive sprigs flying an ascending spiral round the wide part of the tree, through gold rays that shimmer; white pinnacle.

looks.name: Pride
looks.notes: The rainbow flag, ridge to ground, rising slowly; white pinnacle.

looks.name: Progress Pride
looks.notes: Two flags on opposite sides, turned upright: the rainbow in vertical stripes, and the Progress chevron rising from the ground, white at its heart, through pink, light blue and brown to black.

looks.name: Bear
looks.notes: A plaid woven from the bear pride colours: dark brown and rust crossed with gold, tan, white and grey threads.

looks.name: Trans
looks.notes: Light blue, pink, white, pink, light blue, sparkling, with their average, a soft lavender, washing in over them and back out again.

looks.name: Red Ribbon
looks.notes: Two red stripes on opposite sides, slanting opposite ways like the crossing of the ribbon, on black; after a moment, concentric opposing chevrons of red and black fill the whole tree, then draw back to the ribbon.

looks.name: Plaid
looks.notes: Red tartan with green bands, dark threads and a gold line; green pinnacle.

looks.name: Gingerbread
looks.notes: Brown with white icing zigzags and gumdrops in red and green; the pinnacle is icing.

looks.name: Ornaments
looks.notes: Baubles in red, gold, blue, silver and purple on deep green; they twinkle; gold pinnacle.

looks.name: Classic Tree
looks.notes: A green tree hung with gold garland swags, a red bead where each meets the next, and multicoloured bulbs placed irregularly that twinkle; the pinnacle washes gold.

looks.name: White Bulbs
looks.notes: The classic: a deep green tree with individual warm-white bulbs, irregular; the pinnacle washes gold.

looks.name: Joy
looks.notes: JOY on two sides, big block letters with clear gaps, low on the tree where it is widest, white on red between gold bands, with snow falling over it.
